H2_calibration.quote: Operating in reliance on aggressive readings is risky. This applies especially to the §3(c) safety-evaluation exception, offshore subsidiary structures, and run-splitting. The bill carries a 10-year criminal penalty, there is §1001 exposure on certified reports, and courts may read evasion as evidence of willfulness.

H1_holdback.quote: Raising the latter at markup will likely prompt the committee to close them, and staff counsel will probably spot many of them regardless.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: It creates an incentive to formally start a long-running training run before enactment and continue it.
